info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/hunyuan-video
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/hunyuan-video queue.

num_frames.description: The number of frames to generate.
num_frames.title: Number of Frames

resolution.description: The resolution of the video to generate.
resolution.title: Resolution

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the video to generate.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio (W:H)

prompt.description: The prompt to generate the video from.
prompt.title: Prompt
examples: A stylish woman walks down a Tokyo street filled with warm glowing neon and animated city signage. She wears a black leather jacket, a long red dress, and black boots, and carries a black purse.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

pro_mode.title: Pro Mode
pro_mode.description: By default, generations are done with 35 steps. Pro mode does 55 steps which results in higher quality videos but will take more time and cost 2x more billing units.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed to use for generating the video.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed used for generating the video.

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
